part.text:
Implemented incremental builds and caching. Summary of changes:

- **`src/hash.ts`** (new): `hashString`/`hashFile` SHA-256 utilities.
- **`src/cache.ts`** (new): `.ssg-cache.json` manifest (`CachedPage`/`CacheManifest`), `loadManifest`/`saveManifest`/`defaultCacheFile`.
- **`src/templates.ts`**: exported `normalizeTemplateName`; added `templateFingerprint` (hashes resolved layout + partials per page).
- **`src/site.ts`**: `buildSite` now accepts `incremental`, `clean`, `cacheFile`; skips unchanged pages (source + template hash), reuses cached frontmatter/HTML, returns `stats` (`pagesBuilt`, `pagesSkipped`, `timeSavedMs`).
- **`src/cli.ts`**: `--incremental` and `--clean` flags; stats in output.
- **`src/index.ts`**: exports new APIs.
- **`test/incremental.test.ts`** (new): 9 tests covering manifest writing, skip-all, single-source rebuild, per-template rebuild, missing cache, `--clean`, cached frontmatter, file completeness, and new-page rebuild.

All 53 tests pass (existing + new), and `tsc` compiles cleanly.
